Commentary.Commentary: Apart from being a bit slow, there isn't much in this pitch. The start initially against the two new balls will be crucial as in the middle phase, timing the shots will be a bit difficult. It's a modest target on the board but Bangladesh would like to approach carefully. Let's see whether West Indies challenge them this time around with the ball or not. Do join us in a short while.

Earlier, it was Jason Holder's call to bat first and his openers provided a decent start. But soon West Indies found themselves in a precarious situation after losing their top four for only 99 runs. Mehidy and Shakib bowled brilliantly in the middle overs to never allow West Indies off the hook and then the old gun, Mashrafe Mortaza picked the prized wickets of Shai Hope and Jason Holder to peg the opposition back furthermore. Mustafizur Rahman also found some form and finished with a 4-wicket haul.

Terrific bowling performance by Bangladesh! They have restricted West Indies under 250. Once again the major contribution came from one of the top order batsmen but apart from him, there wasn't much fight shown by the middle order. Jason Holder's century partnership with Shai Hope put the Caribbean team on track for a score close to 300 but the Bangla Tigers roared back in the last 10 overs to dismiss both the set batsmen. The desired finish never came for the team in maroon and they managed a below-par total only.

Outside off, Roach hammers this down the ground. Jayed rushes to his left to stop the ball but it hits his shin and deflects towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run. 11 from the final over as West Indies finish 3 shy of 250.
Backs away to the leg side again and swings cleaner this time, but ironically, this is just a single as this one goes to deep mid-wicket. A run taken.

SIX! It is a top edge but the Men in Maroon will not care. They are edging closer to that 250-mark. A short ball, around middle, following the batsman as he backs away, Cottrell swings hard and the top edge flies over long leg!
The batsman fails to get bat on that one and is hit on the pad. Leg bye given by the umpire.
Around middle and off, heaved towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, Roach hops across and defends.
Abu Jayed to bowl the final over. 8-0-46-0 so far.

How did that miss the leg stump? A length ball, outside leg, Cottrell gives himself room and swings hard, only to miss. The ball just misses the leg stump by a whisker. The difference between a Michelle and a 4-fer for the Fizz. 9-1-43-4 today.
Sheldon Cottrell is the last man in. Will the West Indies be able to play out their full quota? One ball left for the Fizz to take a fifer.

OUT! LBW! Wicket number 4 for Mustafizur. Full and straight, swinging in, Reifer plays all around that, looking to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Mustafizur appeals and up goes the finger. That looked dead plumb.
STAT ALERT - Mushfiqur Rahim reached 300 catches in international cricket when he held one to dismiss Shai Hope. Kudos to the Bangladeshi legend!
Outside off, guided towards third man for one.
Full and around middle, flicked uppishly towards wide long on for a run.
Kemar Roach walks in at number 10, with 10 balls left in the game...

OUT! Caught! Not what the doctor ordered the nurse to do. A length ball, around off, Ashley has a heave-ho but mistimes it. The ball goes high in the air but there is not much strength in it. Simple catch for Sabbir Rahman in the deep at mid-wicket.
Full on middle, flicked uppishly over mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, pushed watchfully towards cover. 10-0-60-3 so far.
Comes down the track and has a heave-ho, mistiming his punch towards long off for a run.

Comes down the track, aiming to force the issue but is nowhere near the pitch of the ball. Swings hard but misses. The ball goes off his pads towards the leg side and a leg bye is taken. Or probably not. No signal from the umpire.
On a length, outside off, Reifer taps it towards point and takes a quick single. Bangladesh will not mind these at this stage...
Another flick, another run.
Down the leg side, helped through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Off the top edge. Another short ball in this over, something which Bangladesh are constantly trying. And beating the West Indies batsmen for pace. This is around middle, Nurse looks to pull but is cramped for room. Gets a top edge which flies towards the fine leg fence.
Good bounce off the deck, Raymon looks to fend a short delivery but awkwardly pushes it to the off side and takes a quick single.
A short ball once more, pulled again, but this time connecting with thin air.
A short ball, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

An extra run. A bye. Slower ball, outside off, Reifer looks to defend but the ball comes in, beats the inside edge and lands in front of the keeper. Rahim is a touch surprised and cannot quite collect the ball. It deflects to his right and the batsmen take a single.
A short ball, outside off, pulled powerfully through square leg. Mehidy  Hasan gives it a good chase from deep mid-wicket and keeps the batsmen to a single.
The Fizz is back.

Miscommunication but all okay in the end. Outside off, Nurse looks to punch it through the off side but gets a bottom edge behind. Now, Nurse does not want the single but Reifer calls him through. Rahim charges in and has an under-arm shy at the striker's end as the batsmen eventually go through. Misses the stumps but Reifer is well in. Rahim should have gone for the stumps at the bowler's end...
Another single eked out to the leg side.
Gets across and plays a Nataraja pull shot, that is with his left leg raised in the air, towards fine leg for a single.
Down the leg side, Ashley looks to tuck but misses and is hit on the pads. Another couple of runs to the total, this time as leg byes.
Around middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a brace.
A short ball, Nurse heaves it through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. Shakib ends a brilliant bowling performance from him with figures of 10-1-27-1!!!
Outside off, played straight to point.
Raymon Reifer walks in.

OUT! LBW! Allen is a dead duck. Tossed up, around middle, Allen looks to defend but misses a straight ball and is hit on the pads. Looks out the moment the ball hits the pad and umpire Kettleborough agrees. Two wickets in as many overs, Bangladesh might well be chasing under 250 now...
FOUR! Positive stroke. Full and around off, Allen gets down and sweeps this behind square leg for a boundary!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Around middle and leg, watchfully worked towards short mid-wicket.
Ashley Nurse walks in.

OUT! Caught behind! 'Mash' has struck. The Windies are losing their way here. A length ball, outside off, Holder has a loose waft, aiming to punch it through the off side but there is no feet movement, hence an outside edge results. Simple catch for Rahim. Big wicket for Bangladesh. 250 looks difficult now.
Around middle and leg, Holder misses his flick and is hit on the pads. Mortaza appeals but the umpire is unmoved...
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Around off, watchfully defended.
WIDE. Sprays this down the leg side, Allen misses his flick.
A length ball outside off, worked towards long on for a single.
Presses forward and drives it through covers for a run.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Flatter and on off, punched down to long on for a run.
Tries to flick across the line but it takes the inner half of his blade and rolls behind square leg for one.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Fabian Allen is the next batsman.

OUT! Big breakthrough for Bangladesh and Shai Hope misses out on his third hundred in the series. The change in angle has worked for Mashrafe. He delivers a shortish delivery outside off, Hope stays back to pull it across the line but the ball stays a bit low to take the under edge and Rahim makes no mistake behind the stumps. Top knock from Shai is over! 300th international catch for Rahim.
100-run stand comes up! Full and around off, angling away from 'round the wicket, Holder drives it down to long off for one.
SIX! A nicely timed shot down the ground. A length ball in the line of the stumps, Holder lines up behind it and lofts it cleanly over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Fifty for Holder, his 8th in ODIs! Mortaza angles in a length ball on middle, Holder heaves it over mid-wicket and returns for the second run. Handy knock by the West Indian skipper.
Full this time, outside off, drilled to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Jason Holder has broken the bottom of his bat. He immediately calls for a new one and one of the reserve players comes in with it.
Slower one, a dipping full toss around off, Holder goes hard at it and mishits it off the inside edge to wide of long on. Good enough for a couple of runs.
Mashrafe Mortaza comes back into the attack now! Meanwhile, we see a handful of Bangladeshi fans enjoying themselves in the stands.
Skidding into the batsman, Holder strokes it down to long on for another run to end the over.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and punches it to long on for one.
On a good length outside off, Holder eases it past the cover fielder for a single.
Loopy and full on off, Hope goes inside-out and lofts it towards long off. Will get just a run.
Walks down the track and forces it down to long on for one.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Time for Powerplay 3! West Indies will look for quick runs now but they will have to contend with 5 fielders outside the circle till the end of the innings.
Stands tall inside the crease to a short ball and hits it through point for one. 8 from the over. 180/4 are the West Indies will 60 legal deliveries left.
FOUR! Easily done! All he needed to do was to find the gap. Short and wide ball outside off, Hope goes on his toes and steers it through the gap between point and third man.

This time Shai gets bat on ball. The length is a bit short and around off, Hope stands back and slaps it down to long on and scampers across for a couple of runs. Rahim is heard screaming something maybe in Bangla and my colleague feels that he is irritated there as the fielder in the deep was very lazy in releasing the ball from the deep. Could have been a run out had the throw been sharp at the bowler's end.

Play and a miss! Slower one outside off, angling away from the batsman, Hope sits down on one knee and tries to play the slog sweep but misses. Doesn't matter how set you are, Rahman has this knack of beating any batsman with his variations.

Back of a length ball on off, Holder goes on the back foot and punches it square of the wicket on the off side. Looks for the second run but it's not on as the fielder in the deep quickly charge towards the ball.
Beauty of a delivery! A lovely leg cutter from the Fizz, it's around off and moving away, Holder is opened up in defense and ends up completely missing the ball.
Flatter on the pads, flicked away behind square on the leg side for a run. Holder keeps strike for the next over.
Hope crunches this back foot punch towards extra-cover who makes a half-stop. A single is taken.
Punched back to mid-wicket this time.
Kept out off the back foot back down the ground by Hope.
Another one carved away but straight to the point fielder.
Flatter on off, pushed off the face of the bat towards point.
Shakib Al Hasan is back on.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. A decent over other than that big one.
Slower ball outside off, Holder looks to put bat on ball and push it through the off side but the ball goes past the bat.
Flicked towards fine leg for a run this time by Hope. He gets his skipper on strike.
Back foot defense towards cover.
SIX! The first six of the game! A short ball on middle, Hope lifts this one off the back foot and powers it over long on. Absolutely stylish shot! Moves into the 70s!
On a length wide outside off, cut away to deep cover for a run.
Mustafizur Rahman comes back on.
Flighted outside off, Hope comes ahead and defends the ball on the surface.
This one is bowled on the pads, Holder runs the ball to the left of short fine leg for a single.
Jason flicks this one straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Slower on middle, comes ahead does Holder and he defends the ball to the bowler.
Punched away to long on for a run this time by Shai.
Flatter one on middle, Hope backs away and crunches this wide of extra-cover. Long off runs to his left and mops it up. Two runs taken!
Pushed away to deep cover for a single and Hope retains strike.
Length on the leg stump line, Holder misses his flick. The ball goes off the thigh pad and drops to the right of the surface. A leg bye is taken.
Fuller one on middle, driven away to deep cover for a single by Hope.
On a length outside off, Holder runs it down to third man for a run.
That has gone through! A length ball on middle, Holder looks to whip it away but the ball keeps slightly low and he misses the ball.
Pushed uppishly wide of point by Holder. A couple of runs are picked up!

DRINKS BREAK! Jason Holder and Shai Hope are in the midst of a lovely stand but need to increase the pace now with just 15 overs left if they want to get anywhere near 300. Meanwhile, Bangladesh will hope that a wicket or two can be picked up when the West Indies batsmen accelerate and that will mean that they can limit their opposition to a small total.
Driven wide of long off for a run by Holder. Just 4 runs off this over, excellent bowling.
Tucked towards mid-wicket.
Driven down the ground to long off for a run. Good rotation of strike this.
The batsman has swept that one through the leg side. They have run through for a single.
Flatter outside off, Holder defends off the bottom of the bat towards cover.
Flighted on off, punched back down the ground to long on for a single. The 50-run stand comes up between these two with that.
Flicked away through mid-wicket for a single by the opening batsman. He keeps strike. 8 runs off this over.
Driven hard to mid off but no single can be taken there as the ball goes with good pace to the fielder. The fielder throws wide but the batsmen decide not to run an overthrow.
Wide! The second extra of the innings! Sprayed down the leg side by Abu, he was the one to bowl the first wide as well.
Fuller one on the pads, flicked away with timing to deep square leg. Only a single though.
Fuller one on middle, driven down the ground for a single by SH.
FOUR! Smacked back down the ground. A length ball outside off, Hope brings out the calypso flair and hits it right past the bowler to his left. Boundary results at long off.
Fuller one on middle, flicked by Hope but straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
Too leg side this time and Hope has eased it through square leg for one more run in the over.
Turns it wide of mid-wicket and crosses for a run.

Shout for a caught behind this time, not given again. Tossed up delivery outside off, Holder goes down on one knee to slog it across the line but misses. The keeper collects the ball and appeals but the umpire shows no interest.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.

Uppish but safe! Flatter delivery on middle, Holder takes a big stride forward as he attempts to flick. But it takes the leading edge and goes in the air towards covers. Mustafizur at cover-point could have put in a dive there but decides not to and collects the ball on one bounce. A single is taken.
Appeal for an lbw! A flighted off spinner on off, turning back in with extra bounce, Holder tries flicking but misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Leading edge but safe! A length ball on middle and leg, Holder tries to flick but it takes the leading edge and flies wide of extra cover for one.
Shortish again, forced down the ground to long on for one.
Shortish and on off, helped to mid-wicket.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run.

FOUR! Holder is getting a go now! Jayed angles in a full ball on middle, Jason heaves it across the line and times his shot quite well. It flies over wide mid on and Mosaddek (sub) in the deep tries to run across and pull it back. Fails to do so and his momentum takes him beyond the rope and he collides with someone from the team management sitting out there. No harm done to anyone.
Length ball on off, angling back in, Holder covers the line and pushes it to mid off.
Abu Jayed is back on.
Flicks a full ball with the spin through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Floated and full ball on off, Holder pushes it gently through extra cover and straightaway calls for two. Completes it easily.
Allows the ball to spin back in and easily helps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, it's clipped past the mid-wicket fielder who was lazy in getting down. A single taken.
Fuller and on off, pushed back to the bowler with a straight blade.
Loopy full ball on off, an off spinner, Holder lunges and defends it to the off side.
Mehidy Hasan is back on.
In the channel outside off, Holder calmly runs it down to third man and picks up a single. 11 from the over.
FOUR! One brings two. Holder says let's move on now. The line is around off and the length is on the shorter side, Holder eases himself on the back foot and powers it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Finally a boundary for West Indies, after 102 balls. Quicker short ball on off, Holder knows that mid off is up and hence he pumps it over the in-ring fielder for a boundary.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched back to the bowler.
Full and angling down the leg side, Jason helps it to wide of long on and straightaway calls for two. Completes it with ease.
A little short in length on off, Holder punches it to covers. Plenty of dot balls here.
Stays back footed to a short ball and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Quicker and shorter on middle, Jason goes back to punch it down to long on but mid-wicket intervenes to make the stop.
Walks forward a bit and then pushes it through the line, fails to beat covers again.
Continues to fire it in, Shakib. An arm ball on off, Holder punches it from the back foot to covers.
Once again skidding back into the batsman from around off, Shai goes back and works it through square leg for one.
Skidding down the leg side, Shai attempts to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Shortish and wide outside off, Holder tries his best to slap it through the line but misses.
The line is straight and it's worked through square leg for one.
Hope has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Chance of a run out, MISSED! Holder was gone for all money. The West Indies skipper pushes it a bit aerially towards mid off and Shakib reacts quickly from extra cover. There is a bit of hesitation between the batsmen and then they eventually go for it. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. Holder survives.
Slower one, on a shortish length around off, Hope taps it down towards backward point for a run. Brings up his 9th fifty in ODIs and continues with his rich form in this tri-series.
Back of a length ball on off, angling back in, Jason stands back inside the crease and punches it to long on for a run.
Soumya Sarkar is into the attack.
Walks forward to a full ball and knocks it down to long on for one. Slow going from West Indies in the middle overs after losing the four top order wickets.
Gets behind the line to work it around but fails to time it well.
Tries to defend but gets an inside edge on the leg side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and quicker on middle, worked through square leg again, another run added to the total.
Use of the wrists. Full and on middle, skidding down, Holder eases it through square leg for a run.
False shot! Width on offer outside off, it's an off pace delivery and Shai gets deceived a bit. He is early into his shot and ends up missing the ball completely. Another tidy over.
Slower delivery, a touch short and around off, Holder opens the face of his bat at the last moment and guides it to third man for a run.
A short cover in place now.
Jason has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Brilliant fielding, Sabbir. Just a bit overpitched outside off, angling across, Holder drives it crisply through covers and Sabbir does well in the deep to stop the racing ball. Saves two.
Good bowling. Keeps a wide slip for Holder and angles across a length ball outside off. Jason pokes at it tamely and is beaten.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Shai goes on this toes and taps it down towards mid-wicket. Mustafizur moves across to his right to stop the ball and the batsmen cross for one.
Maiden! This is excellent bowling by Shakib. Not offering anything to the batsman. Keeps his line on and around off, the trajectory is flat and Holder defends it by covering the line.
Loopy delivery on off, Holder presents a straight bat in defense.
Fires one in again, full and on middle, Holder tries flicking but misses and is hit on the pads. Going down again.
Leans forward to a full ball on off and blocks it to the off side.
Arm ball on middle and leg, skidding down, Holder tries working it around but misses and is hit on the pads.
A flighted delivery, landing full on middle, Holder gets forward and pushes it to mid on.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to cover. 1 run and 1 wicket off this over, brilliant stuff!
Really full outside off, Hope times his drive but fails to place the ball.
It's been driven superbly but straight to the fielder at covers.
Guided down to third man this time by Jason. A single is picked up. He gets off the mark and West Indies get to 100 too!
Jason Holder walks out to bat next.
Angling away from the right-hander, Holder looks to run it down fine but fails to put bat on ball.

OUT! THE FIZZ STRIKES AGAIN! One of his strong deliveries this! A ball on length and coming into the left-hander. Carter looks to flick the ball but misses it and gets rapped on the pads. The appeal comes from the Bangladeshis and the finger goes up! This is a double blow for the men from the Caribbean! Bangladesh are well on top here.
Swept hard but the fielder at square leg is there to make a half-stop. A single is hence taken and Carter keeps strike for the next over.
Short of a length outside off, Carter dabs it fine past short third man for a couple of runs.
4th dot in a row! A flatter one on off and middle, kept out by the batsman.
Another defensive stroke by the southpaw showing the full face of the bat.
Hit on the pad but outside the line of off stump. Carter looks to come well ahead to this flighted ball outside off and paddle sweep it. He misses the ball though.
Flighted on off, Carter comes ahead and defends this ball back down the ground.
Driven hard wide of mid off where the fielder makes a half-stop. Allows for the second run to be taken. Hope reaches 47 now!
A length ball outside off, Hope looks initially to play the ball but then pulls off the shot very stylishly.
Punched off the back foot towards mid off by Hope.
Back of a length on middle, Hope flicks it wide of long on. Two runs picked up as the fielder in the deep mops up. The West Indies batsmen think of 3 as well but wisely decide against it.
Another well-timed cut from Hope but he finds the fielder this time at point.
Back of a length outside off, Hope looks to punch this away for a couple of runs fine of third man.
Full and fast, watchfully defended.
Full and around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, driven towards long off for a run.
Landed around middle, Hope looks to tuck it towards the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads.
Around off, looped up slightly, driven back to Shakib again.
Full and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Punched back down the ground by Carter. It goes to the bowler, an excellent over from Mustafizur with another dot. A wicket maiden!
Carter shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On a length on middle, Jonathan works it towards mid-wicket on the front foot.
Back of a length outside off, Carter looks to cut this ball but fails to put the ball away as he misses it.
Back of a length outside off, dabbed down towards the keeper.
Jonathan Carter walks out to bat next.

OUT! Caught at short mid-wicket! Chase departs now. A short length ball on middle, Roston flicks this with good timing but cannot keep it down. The ball goes straight to Mahmudullah who holds on to a sharp catch. Third one for Bangladesh and this wicket will also give a lot of confidence to Mustafizur Rahman.
Flatter on off, kept back towards shortish mid off.
Flatter on off, defends the ball towards cover does Hope.
Flighted on off, Chase runs down the track and drives this to long off for a single.
Worked towards mid-wicket by RC.
Pushed towards cover off the back foot by Roston.
Flighted on off and coming in with the angle, Chase stays tall and defends it back to the bowler.
Shakib Al Hasan comes onto bowl for the first time today!
On a length on off, turned away through square leg and the batsmen pick up the second couple of the over. 6 runs off the Fizz's first.
Pushed towards extra-cover this time off the back foot by Hope. Dot ball.
Cracking drive, goes to the right of the deep cover fielder and two runs are taken easily.
Flicked away again by Hope but this time the ball is straight to the fielder.
Flicked through square leg for a couple of runs by Shai. Lovely batting, he is looking solid.
On a length on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket by Hope.

DRINKS BREAK. After a brisk start by the West Indies openers, Bangladesh have struck twice in quick succession to bring them back on level terms in this game. Currently, Shai Hope and Roston Chase are in the midst of a rebuilding partnership and they would look to bat nice and long here. Meanwhile, another wicket or two here will mean that the Tigers will be right on top! An interesting passage of play lying ahead of us... Mustafizur Rahman to bowl now!
Around off, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fired in outside off, Hope stays back to play that, slips, but manages to ease it towards point.
Around off, worked through square leg for a run.
Outside off, punched back to the bowler.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Full and around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, played with an open bat-face towards cover.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and around middle, flicked uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Full and down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Down the leg side, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
1 run.
Around off, little bit of flight, Hope gets down and dead-bats it.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Good single picked up! Back of a length outside off, Hope pats the ball on the off side for a quick run wide of point.

Almost carried back to the bowler! A back of a length ball on middle, Hope looks to punch this one but the ball holds up in the pitch and goes uppishly back to the bowler. It falls short of him though and Hope is living dangerously here. Two near chances in the last two balls that he has played.
Chase cuts this away for a single through point.

In the air... safe! Just past short fine leg who was running behind to take that. Short ball on middle, Hope looks to pull that one but gets a top edge that has enough on it to clear the fielder luckily for the batsman. One run taken. Bangladesh were so close to having another.
Back of a length outside off, Hope defends it towards cover.
Outside off on a length, Chase looks to push this through the off side but gets it off the inner half. The ball goes through the leg side for a single.
Abu Jayed is back on now.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Around off, worked towards short mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Off the outside edge! Landed outside off, Chase goes back to punch it through the off side but the ball skids through and takes the outside edge. Chase looks to punch it through the off side but the ball skids through, takes the outside edge and goes past first slip towards the third man.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.

Another loud appeal but again turned down! A length ball on off and swinging in after landing. Chase misses the ball but is hit above the knee roll. The umpire hence believes it is too high and turns down the appeal! Good bowling this though from Mortaza.
Back of a length on middle, Chase looks to flick but gets hit high on the pad.
Pushes this one off the face of the bat towards point.
On a length outside off, nips into the batsman. Chase looks to cut but it is too close for him to do so.
FOUR! Poor fielding! A length ball on middle, flicked away by Chase. Mahmudullah there should have done better but fails to stop the ball. Allows it to go through him for a boundary.

Loud appeal! Sliding down leg probably! A length ball on middle and leg, going straight with the angle too. Chase misses his flick and gets hit above the knee roll. There is a loud appeal but the umpire is not fazed.
Chase gets off the mark with a flick through mid-wicket for a single. He keeps strike for the next over.
A flatter one on middle, pushed back with a straight bat from the crease by Roston now.
Defended back down the ground to the bowler by Chase.
Roston Chase is the next man in.

OUT! The finger goes up and Bravo's stay in the middle is brought to an end. He never looked too comfortable anyway. A flatter one bowled on off and going straight with the angle, Darren looks to defend but plays down the wrong line. He gets rapped in front of the wicket and the bowler appeals! The finger goes up too, West Indies lose their second. Bangladesh fighting back strongly after the brisk start here.
Flatter and shorter this time, punched back down the ground for a single to long on.
Fuller this time, pushed back to the bowler by Hope.
Powerplay 2 time! A maximum of 4 fielders can be outside the inner circle now till the end of the 40th over!
Around the wicket and bowls this on a length, Bravo pushes this towards the point region. West Indies are 55/1 after 10 overs.
On the hips, turned away towards the left of short fine leg for a single by Hope.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They have run through for a single.

DROPPED! This could be a huge miss! A slower ball from Mortaza on a length, Bravo goes for a nothing shot without any foot movement. The ball takes the top edge and goes high in the air towards cover-point. Mehidy comes ahead to take that but never settled under it and ends up spilling an easy chance. Poor, poor fielding!
Back of a length on middle, worked away through mid-wicket for a single. Smart batting, taking a single after the boundary.

Short on middle and leg, Hope swivels and pulls this past short fine leg off the inner half of his bat. The ball ends up crossing the boundary fine on the leg side. Good start to the over for West Indies.
No, it is not a maiden! A flatter one on off, it is punched down the ground to long on for a single by Hope and he keeps strike for the next over.
Flatter on middle, patted back down the ground. 5 dots, will this be a maiden?
Flicked but the ball goes straight to square leg.
Off spinner on middle, Hope rocks onto the back foot and punches this one to mid-wicket.
Pushed back to the right of the bowler, Mehidy runs there and stops the ball.
Flighted ball on off and middle, Hope pushes it towards the right of mid-wicket and wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
Pushed back to the bowler again. 4 runs off this over, a brilliant one other than the boundary.
Back of a length, defended by DB again staying nice and tall.
On a length outside off, Darren defends the ball back down the ground.

FOUR! Flair from Bravo! A length ball outside off, Bravo just lifts it over mid off's head and gets the boundary. The ball lands just inches inside the rope and replays confirm it is just four and not six.
Bravo goes ahead and drives this one towards cover. One hand is off the bat as the shot is completed.
Back of a length on middle, Bravo pushes it towards mid on. Good ball.

FOUR! This time though the ball is well away from the bowler as well as mid off. Hope uses his wrists to drive this past mid off to his left. The fielder did not even try to reach that ball, it was so well timed.
Flighted on off, Hope pushes ahead and drives this ball to the left of the bowler but Mehidy gets a hand to it by diving to his left. Saves a boundary there.
Off the mark but in a sneaky way! Bravo comes ahead to defend this ball on off, the ball goes off the inside edge and towards the leg side for a single.
Lots of air on that one on middle and off, Darren comes ahead and defends.
Hope comes ahead to this flighted one on off and drives it down to long on for a single.
Flatter one on off first up, Hope watches the ball and defends it towards the leg side going back in his crease.
Spin time. Mehidy Hasan comes on to bowl!
From around the wicket to the lefty, left alone by Bravo. A successful over comes to an end. Just 2 runs and a wicket off it in the end.
Darren Bravo walks out at number 3.

OUT! Mortaza breaks the opening stand! It was looking dangerous for Bangladesh but the captain delivers. Huge wicket of Ambris, the Man of the Match in the previous game. A length ball outside off, slight away movement, very slight. Ambris looks to poke it down to third man but gets a thick outside edge that flies to the right of the only slip. Sarkar there though leaps to his right and holds on for a terrific catch! Just the break that the Asian side wanted.
On a length outside off once more, Ambris pushes this one to cover from the crease.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through outside off.
On a length on middle, nudged towards the right of mid on for a single by Hope.
Short of a length on middle, pulled away by Ambris for a single through square leg.

Shot! Good fielding too! Definitely saved a boundary there, the fielder at extra-cover. A fuller one outside off, Hope drives gorgeously and the ball was surely meant to go to the fence but the fielder dives to his right and somehow gets a hand to it. 2 runs are taken as the ball goes to the left of mid off.
On a length, swinging into the batsman after landing on off, Hope keeps it out with ease though.
Driven this time nicely but finds the fielder at mid off again does Hope.
Fuller one on off, defended towards mid off by the batsman.
Landed outside off, this is left alone.
FOUR! FLAMBOYANT! No need to run for that. Full and wide outside off, Hope reaches out, leans and drives it through the covers! Moves to 10 from 10 balls.
Back of a length on the hips, flicked towards short fine leg by the batsman. A single is taken and Shai keeps strike for the next over.
Driven hard but straight back at the bowler. Dot ball.
FOUR! On the pads and flicked away easily. Fuller length on the pads, Hope just has to glance it away past the fielder inside the circle and he does so easily.
This ball lands short of a length and straightens, Ambris gets a thick outside edge that goes wide of point to third man for a single.
Slower ball on middle, Ambris waits for the ball to come to him before flicking it to mid-wicket.
On a length outside off, Ambris pushes this ball towards point.
On a length on off, Hope defends this from the crease. Another 9-run over, this is a really good start for the West Indies.
Fuller length ball outside off, Hope pushes this one towards mid off coming ahead.
On a length outside off, patted calmly towards third man for a single by Ambris.
Somneone running in front of the sightscreen... a slight delay.

FOUR! Crashed through the covers for four! His fourth boundary, Ambris! A length ball outside off, not much wrong with the ball but that is just a very classy shot. Once it goes past the infield, there is no stopping that.
Fuller length ball on middle, Ambris defends it back down the ground.

FOUR! Loose shot but Ambris gets it in the gap. A fuller ball outside off, Sunil just hits it aerially wide of mid off without any foot movement. Gets it in the gap luckily or it could have been caught. Boundary results this time though.
On a length outside off, patted towards cover by the batsman watchfully. 9 runs off this over, a good one for the batting side!
On the middle and leg stump line, flicked wide of mid on for a single by Ambris. The batsmen were thinking of two there but decide against it in the end.
Wide outside off, Ambris looks to slash the ball away but fails to make contact. Missed out there, was a boundary scoring opportunity that.
Finds the fielder this time. On a length and on the pads, Ambris flicks the ball towards short fine leg.
FOUR! Two in two for Sunil. A short ball on middle, Ambris pulls this behind square on the leg side this time. It reaches the rope once more. Ambris looks supremely confident here.
FOUR! Mortaza has been welcomed with a boundary. A length ball on middle, Ambris pulls through the line and in front of square for a boundary.
Mashrafe Mortaza to bowl with the other new ball.

Good fielding! A fuller length ball on off, Ambris wants to drive that down the ground but the ball goes wide of point to his right. The fielder gives chase and keeps the ball inside with a brilliant diving stop. Saves 1 run for his side. A decent first over for Abu Jayed.
Fuller outside off, driven by Sunil coming ahead towards mid off. Good timing on that one but straight to the fielder.
On a length on middle, Ambris defends his first ball solidly back down the ground. He looks really confident. Who would not be after that knock in the previous game?
Good ball but Hope gets off the mark. A length ball on middle, Hope tries to pat the ball towards the leg side but the ball goes off the outside half towards the off side. A quick single is taken.
Outside off on a length and comes in late, Hope lets the ball go through after covering its line.
Fuller length ball on off this time, Hope comes ahead and pushes the ball towards mid off.
Not the best start in ODI cricket for Abu. He sprays this one down the leg side and it is wided by the umpire. West Indies off the mark without a ball being bowled.

Time for the first ball! The fielders of Bangladesh take their positions while the two openers for West Indies, Sunil Ambris and Shai Hope take theirs. Abu Jayed, the debutant has the first new ball. Let's play!
The two teams are getting lined up in the middle for the national anthems. A lovely scene under the pleasant sun at the Malahide Cricket Club Ground.

Bangladesh XI - Tamim Iqbal, Soumya Sarkar, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mohammad Mithun, Mahmudullah, Sabbir Rahman, Mashrafe Mortaza (C), Mehidy Hasan, Abu Jayed (IN FOR MOHAMMAD SAIFUDDIN), Mustafizur Rahman.

West Indies XI - Shai Hope (WK), Sunil Ambris, Darren Bravo, Roston Chase, Jonathan Carter, Jason Holder (C), Fabian Allen, Ashley Nurse, Kemar Roach, Raymon Reifer (IN FOR SHANNON GABRIEL), Sheldon Cottrell.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza says that they wanted to bat first as well but now hopes they can limit West Indies to a total that they can chase down. He feels that it is an important game for them as they can win and go through to the final. He informs that they have been practising for the last 2-3 days and expect to have a good match. Tells us that they too have one change, Abu Jayed comes in for Mohammad Saifuddin who has a back injury.

West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says it looks like a very good wicket and that they want to make first use of it. Mentions that they want improvement in every game and want to continue the way they have been batting having given a lot of good performances so far. States they need to tighten up a bit in the field as they have been a bit sloppy. Informs that they have one change, Raymon Reifer makes his debut, coming in for Shannon Gabriel.
TOSS - West Indies win the coin flip. THEY DECIDE TO BAT FIRST!!!

It is time for the 5th ODI of the tri-nation series! Bangladesh facing West Indies but Ireland will be watching closely and will hope that the men from the Caribbean win or else the hosts will be knocked out. Bangladesh just need a win to seal their spot in the final against the Island nation who have already sealed theirs. A lot to play for, West Indies too would love to give a player or two rest before the final and make use of this game to get some valuable practice! Remember they also did lose their earlier game against Bangladesh and revenge would also be on their mind. Should be a good game, stay tuned! The toss is not far away...
